messages:
sara: heads up, i enabled a small console flow in sandbox: admins can tweak feature-flag cache TTLs. intended for faster mitigation during incidents but want a safety review before enabling prod

miguel: who can change TTLs? and does the change affect active snapshots or only future snapshots?

sara: admin-only for now. UI offers two choices: 'apply to new snapshots only' (safe) or 'apply to active snapshots' (immediate). current default was active, i'll flip to new-by-default unless objections

tarun: telemetry: emit event 'flag.ttl.change' with flag_id, old_ttl, new_ttl, actor, trace_id. increment metric 'flag.ttl.updates_total' with env tag. also derive 'cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_flag' for short-lived gating alerts

emily-dx: UX: show a 7d sparkline of cache hit-rate + avg latency near the TTL editor so owners see impact. require a confirmation checkbox 'I understand this may change cache behavior'

sara: good catches, i'll add the checkbox and sparkline

jess-runbooks: runbook proposal: if cache hit-rate rises >15% vs baseline within 5m, revert TTL to previous value and clear prefix cache. notify flag owner and oncall. can deploy-bot create a revert suggestion?

deploy-bot: created task #6234 - 'ttl-regression-revert-suggestion' with checklist template. (automated) :white_check_mark:

miguel: API: require optimistic locking on PATCH TTL. use If-Match with etag and return 412 on mismatch. snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/flags/:id
Headers: If-Match: \"<etag>\"
Body: { "ttl_seconds": 900, "apply_to_active_snapshots": false }
```

tarun: also sample 1/1k requests with header 'x-flag-ttl-snapshot' containing the active ttl for debug traces. temporary alert rule: if 'cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_flag' increases >15% in 5m, open suggestive revert and low-sev pager to ops

emily-dx: console: add TTL change timeline entries (who/when/why) and a rollback button that pre-fills previous TTL and offers to clear cache when permitted

sara: plan: 1) default to 'new snapshots only', 2) emit 'flag.ttl.change' event + counter, 3) add sparkline + checkbox + timeline, 4) optimistic locking via etag, 5) sampling header, 6) wire alert prototype. i'll push to staging tomorrow and ask for a 15m quick-check

jess-runbooks: i'll draft the rollback playbook + notification templates now

miguel: one more: include 'recent_deploy_id' in the TTL event if a deploy occurred in last 20m so we can correlate changes

sara: noted, will update sandbox and post staging link here. thanks all :pray:
